Opened automatically by .github/workflows/migration-drift-recovery.yml.

Every file here is APPLIED to prod already. `db push` matches on version and
skips an applied migration, so nothing in this commit is re-run. The files exist
so migration-versions stops failing on every PR in the repo, `db push` stops
refusing to run, and a rebuild from zero produces the same schema.

Content comes from one of two sources, in order of preference: the authoring
commit when the migration exists on some branch (keeps the real file and its
comments), otherwise a reconstruction from schema_migrations.statements verified
by md5 against a server-computed digest.

statements holds the PARSED statements, so trailing semicolons are stripped
(re-added on rebuild) and the original comment header is NOT recorded. For
reconstructed files the reasoning that accompanied the migration is gone.

Review what each migration DID: arriving via MCP apply_migration means it was
applied without review once already.
